manifest_security.title: Application is Debuggable
manifest_security.description: android:debuggable="true" allows attackers to attach a debugger to the running app via adb, inspect memory, bypass certificate pinning, and extract sensitive data at runtime. Must be false in release builds.

manifest_security.title: Low Target SDK Version (27)
manifest_security.description: targetSdkVersion=27 opts out of security improvements introduced in Android 9+ (Pie), including default HTTPS enforcement, restricted access to device identifiers, and background restrictions. Target SDK 28 or higher is strongly recommended.

code_findings.description: Data written to external storage is readable by any app with READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission. Do not store sensitive data on SD card or external volumes.

code_findings.title: Sensitive Data in Log Statement
code_findings.description: Log.d/e/i/v/w() call contains keywords suggesting sensitive data (password, token, key, secret, auth, credential). Log output is accessible to other apps via logcat on unpatched or rooted devices.

code_findings.title: printStackTrace() Leaks Stack Information
code_findings.description: printStackTrace() prints internal class names, method names, and file paths to logcat, aiding reverse engineering and revealing architectural details to attackers.
